name: Regions Hospital summer volunteer program
what_you_do: A 10 to 12 week summer volunteer program at Regions Hospital and HealthPartners clinics. Most shifts are 2 to 4 hours once a week, and no health care experience is needed.
who_can_apply: Ages 15 and up. Some roles have higher age limits, such as 16 and up in the Breast Health Care Center and 18 and up for some patient roles.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Perks include free parking and meal vouchers.
duration: 10 to 12 weeks, usually 2 to 4 hours once a week
deadline_text: The page says to apply for the summer program between January 1 and April 30, with no year shown. Late applications are not considered.
how_to_apply: Complete the online volunteer application between January 1 and April 30, then finish the three-step process and orientation. Teens need a signed parent consent form.
notes: The summer program is very competitive. A year-round program (at least six months or 100 hours) is also open from age 15; see the HealthPartners high school volunteer card. Volunteer Services: 651-254-5709, volunteerservices@healthpartners.com.
